candidates.source_name: Finance.si (Časnik Finance) — business daily, banking & IT procurement coverage
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenia's only business daily; routinely reports which vendor won a bank/state financial-sector contract, contract values, and disputes. Covers private-bank vendor switches that no public register records.
candidates.access_status: paywalled (hard paywall on most articles; headlines/leads free)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor RSS/section pages and headline+lead only; keep full-text collection to licensed subscription access; store citations not article bodies.
queries_used: Finance.si javno naročilo banka razpis izbrani ponudnik
candidates.observed_blocker: subscription paywall on article bodies (hypothesis, not verified this run)

candidates.why_relevant: Leading national daily; covers contested tenders, cancelled procurements and state-owned bank (NLB, SID) vendor decisions. Archive at old.delo.si carries older procurement stories (e.g. Banka Slovenije banknote-processing procurement).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Section + site-search crawl for headlines/metadata; manual read of hits.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search result (verified article URL returned by search)
queries_used: Finance.si javno naročilo banka razpis izbrani ponudnik

candidates.source_name: Svet kapitala (Delo) — capital markets & finance magazine
candidates.why_relevant: Delo's dedicated finance/capital vertical; longer-form pieces on bank strategy, fintech vendors and digitalisation projects — useful for private-sector contract signals absent from registers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Section crawl + keyword alerting on vendor and bank names.
queries_used: Svet kapitala banke IT ponudnik pogodba članek

candidates.why_relevant: National daily with investigative record on disputed public procurement, DKOM appeals and state-sector IT contracts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Site search + RSS keyword monitoring ('razpis', 'javno naročilo', bank names).
queries_used: Dnevnik.si Večer.com sporen razpis bančne storitve revizijska komisija DKOM

candidates.why_relevant: Strong NE-Slovenia coverage (Nova KBM/OTP heritage, Maribor institutions); named among outlets reporting on DKOM matters, so a genuine carrier of tender-dispute detail.
queries_used: Dnevnik.si Večer.com sporen razpis bančne storitve revizijska komisija DKOM

candidates.source_name: STA — Slovenska tiskovna agencija (Slovenian Press Agency)
candidates.why_relevant: Wire service; first and often only report of contract signings, tender cancellations and DKOM rulings. Its items are syndicated across Slovene media, so STA text is the upstream of most coverage.
candidates.access_status: mixed — free public items plus paid wire (STA also runs English service)
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; commercial licensing for full wire
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Free public feed + english.sta.si monitoring; consider licensed feed for systematic capture.
queries_used: STA banka podpisala pogodbo informacijski sistem plačila razpis

candidates.source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) — 'Medijske objave o DKOM' media-clippings page
candidates.why_relevant: The regulator itself curates a list of media articles about procurement disputes it has ruled on — an efficient pointer from press coverage back to the underlying tender and vice versa.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scrape of the clippings list; snowball each cited outlet/article to the matching DKOM decision.
queries_used: Dnevnik.si Večer.com sporen razpis bančne storitve revizijska komisija DKOM

candidates.why_relevant: Technical trade press covering ATM/self-service hardware, core banking and card systems; publishes vendor-level detail (who supplies what) that general press omits. Confirmed ATM-technology feature.
queries_used: Monitor.si Računalniške novice banka bankomati kartično procesiranje pogodba

candidates.source_name: Računalniške novice — IT trade biweekly + vendor-partner directory
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes vendor press releases about signed contracts (e.g. first contract for a named e-service) and maintains partner profiles including Bankart (the Slovene card-processing utility) — doubles as an actor-map pointer.
candidates.source_subtype: IT trade press / vendor PR channel
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/keyword crawl; treat PR items as vendor-claimed (lower credibility) but high signal for 'who signed with whom'.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search — multiple article URLs returned
queries_used: Monitor.si Računalniške novice banka bankomati kartično procesiranje pogodba

candidates.why_relevant: Publishes plain-language explainers of procurement regulation (e.g. Uredba o finančnih zavarovanjih pri javnem naročanju) — supplies the legal vocabulary and rule changes needed to interpret award notices.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted article fetch when a rule change is flagged elsewhere.
queries_used: Finance.si javno naročilo banka razpis izbrani ponudnik

candidates.source_name: JNP d.o.o. — portal za javna naročila (procurement consultancy portal)
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial procurement-advisory portal indexing misdemeanour decisions and Q&A on bidder/contracting-authority conduct; a bridge between press coverage and case law, and a map of the practitioner community.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl free case summaries; snowball to named authorities and bidders.
queries_used: Finance.si javno naročilo banka razpis izbrani ponudnik

candidates.source_name: Odvetnik Marovt — procurement law firm blog ('Kaj je v ponudbi javno?')
candidates.why_relevant: Specialist procurement lawyer explains exactly which bid data (unit prices, total contract value) are public after award — directly governs what a collector can lawfully expect to obtain from Slovene tender files.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read for access-rights rules; periodic re-check.
queries_used: Finance.si javno naročilo banka razpis izbrani ponudnik

candidates.source_name: Informacijski pooblaščenec (IPRS) — ZDIJZ FAQ and opinions
candidates.why_relevant: Defines the FOI route Slovene journalists use to obtain bank/state contract values, including special ZDIJZ duties for banks that received stability measures — the mechanism behind the media disclosures this cell tracks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read guidance; use decisions database to find precedents about bank contracts.
queries_used: Necenzurirano Pod črto ZDIJZ pogodba banka vrednost razkritje javno naročilo

candidates.source_name: Komisija za preprečevanje korupcije (KPK) — procurement corruption-risk analyses
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes analyses of corruption risk in procurement that name recurring patterns and sectors; its Erar/Supervizor spending transparency work is the standard cross-check journalists use on contract claims.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: PDF harvest of analyses; follow through to Erar for payment-level cross-checks.
queries_used: Necenzurirano Pod črto ZDIJZ pogodba banka vrednost razkritje javno naročilo

candidates.source_name: Žurnal24 — popular daily (banking IT incident reporting)
candidates.why_relevant: Covers customer-visible failures of bank core-system migrations (e.g. BKS Bank information-system problems) — such incidents reveal which vendor/system a private bank actually switched to.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword alerting on bank names + 'informacijski sistem', corroborate before use.
queries_used: STA banka podpisala pogodbo informacijski sistem plačila razpis

candidates.why_relevant: Practitioner forum where bank IT migrations and card-issuing problems (e.g. Nova KBM/Abanka card merger issues) are discussed with technical specificity and timing well ahead of press coverage.
candidates.legal_status: user-generated; copyright of posters; treat as unverified rumour
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Thread search on bank/vendor names; use only as lead generation, never as evidence.
queries_used: Monitor.si Računalniške novice banka bankomati kartično procesiranje pogodba

candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) — Bančni vestnik and ABC bančnih izrazov
candidates.why_relevant: Banking association: its glossary supplies the authoritative Slovene banking vocabulary for query building, and Bančni vestnik articles name systems/vendors and sector projects; also maps member banks (the buyer universe).

candidates.source_name: RTVSLO / MMC — public broadcaster news portal
candidates.why_relevant: Free, archive-stable national coverage of procurement disputes and state-sector contracts; useful open substitute where Finance/Delo/Večer are paywalled.

candidates.discovered_via_method: inferred from cell logic (not returned by this run's searches)

negative_findings.description: The available web search is US-region biased and did not surface Slovene news articles for tightly scoped sl-language queries; it repeatedly returned regulatory/legal PDFs instead of press articles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Seed queries about disputed bank tenders returned law texts (Uradni list, ejn.gov.si, KPK) rather than Finance.si/Dnevnik/Večer articles.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Media-cell candidates could be named and URL-rooted, but individual example articles proving each outlet covers bank tenders could not be enumerated for most outlets; collection should be done via each outlet's own site search rather than a general web index.

negative_findings.description: No concrete article found evidencing a Slovene bank switching card-processing provider, despite a dedicated sl query.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'novica banka zamenjala ponudnika kartičnega procesiranja' equivalent returned Bankart product documentation and a forum thread, no news article.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Card-processing vendor switches are a core A2 signal; absence here is a search-coverage gap, not evidence that no such coverage exists.

negative_findings.description: Slovenia's three most contract-detailed outlets (Finance.si, Večer, partly Delo/Dnevnik) sit behind subscription paywalls.
negative_findings.result_summary: Paywall status asserted from general knowledge and typical behaviour; NOT verified by fetch in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Systematic collection of the highest-value cell content requires paid subscriptions or a licensed press-clipping service; budget/legal decision needed before the collection stage.

negative_findings.description: Investigative outlets Necenzurirano.si and Pod črto (podcrto.si) were targeted as likely ZDIJZ-driven contract-disclosure publishers but no matching article was returned.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query returned only ejn.gov.si, KPK and IPRS material.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These two are the most probable Slovene sources of FOI-obtained contract values; they should be re-checked directly on-site rather than dropped.

coverage_gaps.description: Investigative non-profit media (Necenzurirano.si, Pod črto, Oštro.si) not confirmed in this run despite being the archetype for FOI-based contract revelations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch each site's own search for 'javno naročilo', 'banka', 'pogodba', 'ZDIJZ' and add as candidates in a follow-up pass.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language Slovene business coverage (STA English, Slovenia Times, Total Slovenia News) not enumerated; the cell is sl-weighted by design but en cross-checks aid triage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add english.sta.si and one or two English Slovene business outlets as low-priority corroboration sources.

coverage_gaps.description: No Slovene press-clipping/aggregation service identified (e.g. Kliping, Press Clipping d.o.o.) that would give licensed full-text across paywalled outlets in one feed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout commercial Slovene media-monitoring vendors as a single-contract route around multiple paywalls.

coverage_gaps.description: Archive depth of the paywalled dailies (how far back site search reaches, and whether old.delo.si-style legacy archives exist for Finance/Dnevnik/Večer) is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe each outlet's archive boundary and note the legacy-domain pattern (old.delo.si worked) before defining a historical baseline.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor-side actor map is thin: only Bankart surfaced explicitly; no confirmation of press coverage naming international processors/ATM vendors in Slovenia.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run vendor-name-anchored sl queries (Bankart, Halcom, Hal E-Bank, NCR, Diebold, Nexi, Printec) against each media candidate's own site search.

brief: Slovene-language press is a genuinely load-bearing A2 layer for Slovenia: the state registers publish the award, but Finance.si, Delo/Svet kapitala, Dnevnik, Večer and the STA wire carry the contested detail — why a tender was annulled, who appealed to DKOM, and which vendor a private bank quietly replaced. Two structural features shape collection: the highest-value outlets (Finance.si, Večer, parts of Delo/Dnevnik) are paywalled, while the free layer (STA, RTVSLO, IT trade press Monitor and Računalniške novice, plus forum chatter on Slo-Tech) is where vendor names and system migrations actually appear. Regulator-side pointers are unusually strong here: DKOM publishes its own media-clippings index linking coverage to rulings, and IPRS/KPK document the ZDIJZ route journalists use to extract contract values. This run was hampered by a US-biased search index that returned legal texts rather than articles, so outlet-level candidates are well grounded but per-article evidence is thin and site-native search should drive the next pass.
